Propane cutting with an Acetylene Rig

If you can connect the acetylene hose to the propane cylinder, that will work rather well. In saying that, you will probably find the adapter doesn't fit. But if it does or you can find/ get one made. Then you are onto a good thing.
So the big part is just connecting the hose to the torch? I've read that I would need a different cutting tip.

All you need are tips and a regulator that fits on your propane cylinder. Depending on your needs your can get away with knock off tips frim china for a cheap deal.

The hoses 'should' be T type but regular ones will work fine, just keep an eye out for degradation of the lines. Just like using a propane regulator on an acetylene tank will kill it, the pressure it too high.

There are quick connects that exist for welding hoses, so let's say you have two sets of hoses & a 'Y' split on your oxygen regulator, you can switch lines quickly. I wouldn't put a 'y' between the acetylene & lp cylinder because you'd have to add extra flow check valves affecting the gas pressure to the torch. Plus I wouldn't want either gasses reverse flowing into the other tank if one fails.
